title: Find a function signature in the Python docs

turns.prompt: From the official Python documentation at https://docs.python.org/3/ find the exact full signature of json.dumps (all keyword parameters with their defaults) and write it on one line to {D}/sig.txt. Then quote it to me.
turns.verify: f={D}/sig.txt; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no sig.txt; exit 0; }; sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f; grep -q skipkeys $f && grep -q indent $f && grep -q sort_keys $f && echo PASS || echo FAIL: signature incomplete

rubric.criteria: The signature matches the real json.dumps signature: obj, *, skipkeys=False, ensure_ascii=True, check_circular=True, allow_nan=True, cls=None, indent=None, separators=None, default=None, sort_keys=False, **kw.
